workload.description: descended S3 (m = 2) in Weierstrass x, Wu Kummer ratio k = x/d, Wu u = d/(x+d), binary Edwards w, on icv1-f2m15-tm275-2d22ff5d, icv1-f2m15-t5-d9fb183e, icv1-f2m17-t101-e6c4b64d, icv1-f2m17-t209-0eba1a1e (uniform affine targets)

metric: F4 word XORs per solve (median over targets x rounds)
note: Wu u is a Mobius frame of x and equals the FGHR frame (u -> u+1 is translation by T); k is x rescaled. S3 terms/total degree: x and k 5/4, u 11/6. Word ops u vs x: 1.2-1.4x fewer at n = 15, 3.1x more at n = 17; binary Edwards w is an E/<T> coordinate, 5.7-7.5x more. No model uniformly cheaper; root sets equal brute force everywhere.
